facts.fact: StackAdapt ranked 21st in the 2019 Technology Fast 50 program with 843% revenue growth from 2015 to 2018.
facts.quote: StackAdapt ranks 21 with 843% in revenue growth from 2015 to 2018.

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 program ranks technology companies by revenue-growth percentage over the past four years.
facts.quote: The program recognizes technology companies with the highest revenue-growth percentage over the past four years.

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, a company must have been in business for at least four years.
facts.quote: companies must have been in business for at least four years

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, a company must have revenues of at least $5 million.
facts.quote: have revenues of at least $5 million

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, a company must be headquartered in Canada.
facts.quote: be headquartered in Canada, own proprietary technology

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, a company must invest a minimum of five percent of gross revenues in R&D.
facts.quote: invest a minimum of five percent of gross revenues in R&D.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's platform was launched in 2014, according to CEO Ildar Shar.
facts.quote: the StackAdapt platform was launched in 2014
